# Engineering Standup

## Overview
This page documents the updates, blockers, wins, and action items discussed during the [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) engineering standup on July 1.

## Key Details
- **[Mira](./nova-widget.md):** Version 0.3.8 has been released. Monitoring GitHub issues closely for any rejoin regressions.
- **Jonah:** The gasket vendor quote for IP65 remains at $8k; the board has advised waiting.
- **Author (Me):** Compiled the wiki featuring [Heuristic Mode](./heuristic-mode.md), bringing the total to over 40 pages.
- **Blockers:**
  - Alex's blog battery typo (referencing CR2450) is still indexed somewhere.
  - The homelab forum scrape parser is currently broken when dealing with nested quotes.
- **Wins:**
  - Acquired 3 new [Beta Testing](./beta-testing.md) testers from thread #9102.
  - Alex sent a pebble-shaped stress ball as a joke gift via [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md).
- **Todo:** Run the extended dummy data generator prior to the upcoming demo.
